key_point: Celeste began as a four-day project
title: Celeste began as a four-day project
caption: Celeste started as a game made in four days for a game jam. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #celeste #indiegames

instagram.caption:
In 2015, Maddy Thorson and Noel Berry made a tiny platformer in four days on the PICO-8 fantasy console. It was called Celeste.

They expanded it into a full game about Madeline climbing a mountain while fighting anxiety and depression.

Players wrote that it helped them through hard times. The original four-day version is hidden inside the full game.

Did you get all the strawberries?
